name: Rebelde
description: A group of young adults will spend their adolescence at the Elite Way School, where they will learn about love, life and live their passion for music.

videos.title: ¿Dónde vas a estudiar?
videos.overview: After doing a bawdy dance in front of all the students, Mía ends up being punished by her father. Miguel decides to move to Mexico City to find the family of the man who killed his father. Meanwhile, Roberta shows her famous mother how rebellious she is.

videos.title: Exámenes de admisión
videos.overview: Mia meets Roberta and offers to give her a makeover, but she takes it the wrong way. Lupita, accompanied by her aunt Mayra, applies for a scholarship at the Elite Way School. Miguel is not allowed to take the school entrance exam.

videos.title: Intercambio de favores
videos.overview: Lupita's aunt manages to arrange for Miguel to take his exam, and in return, she asks him to look after her niece. Vico flirts with Diego. Miguel meets Mía, and they develop an attraction for each other. Celina is also drawn to him, but she struggles with insecurities about her weight.

videos.title: Amenazas y ataques
videos.overview: Mía pretends that she doesn't like Miguel and makes fun of him in front of Celina. Diego threatens Roberta for standing up for Vico. In Valle de Bravo, Roberta tries to get Mauro's attention by pretending to drown. Diego gets into a fight and is injured with a knife.

videos.title: Engaños y malentendidos
videos.overview: After injuring Diego, his attackers stage everything to make it look like a robbery. Miguel rescues Diego and hides the truth. Celina gets angry with Mía and Vico due to a misunderstanding. Miguel fights with Mía at the edge of a cliff.

videos.title: Peleas
videos.overview: At the edge of a cliff, Miguel humiliates Mía for what she did to Celina. Diego tries to find his attackers, but his dad stops him. Mía decides to conceal what happened with Miguel and apologizes to Celina. Roberta fights with Alma and insults her.

videos.title: Besos falsos y verdaderos
videos.overview: Franco visits Mía and promises not to travel as much anymore. Miguel expresses his admiration to Franco, but plans to destroy him. Mía discovers Miguel in her room. Roberta kisses Mauro and José tries to make her appreciate her mom. Vico believes that Mía and Diego kissed.

videos.title: Declaración de amor
videos.overview: Miguel asks Celina to be his girlfriend. Roberta begs the principal not to fire Mauro. Diego and Roberta make each other's lives miserable. Everyone thinks that Roberta is the one writing the anonymous notes. The principal takes charge of the Vacance Club.

videos.title: Enfermedad fingida
videos.overview: Roberta pretends to be sick to be able to leave school. Mía wants a photograph of her mom. Diego tries to intimidate Roberta. Miguel hits Nico for insulting him and leaves him unconscious.

videos.title: Lupita y Roberta ¿amigas?
videos.overview: Roberta convinces Lupita not to change dormitories. Pascual finds Diego's wallet among Roberta's belongings and accuses her of being a thief. Nico lies to save Miguel. León threatens to send Diego to military school.

videos.title: Desmentida, inventos y humillación
videos.overview: Celina confronts Lupita and asks her to stop harassing Miguel. León bribes Pascual with a car. Lupita manages to prove Roberta's innocence, and Diego publicly apologizes to her. Mía takes photos of Miguel with Lupita and confronts him.

videos.title: Falsa acusación
videos.overview: Franco sues Alma for defamation. Pilar discovers that the bribe to her father is true. Tomás has a secret admirer. Giovanni accuses Pilar of writing the anonymous notes. Roberta secures a new audition for the dance group.

videos.title: Falta de sinceridad
videos.overview: Mía can't help but dream about Miguel and imagines herself kissing him. Roberta confesses to her mother that she made up the rumor about her stalker. Tomás thinks Pilar is his secret admirer. Miguel introduces himself to Celina's mother as her boyfriend.

videos.title: Bofetadas y verdades
videos.overview: Miguel continues to be with Celina because he doesn't want to hurt her. Tomás tries to take advantage of Pilar, thinking she is his secret admirer. Alma clarifies the rumors about the alleged harassment. Vico kisses Tomás to get back at Diego.

videos.title: Celos, mentiras y confianza
videos.overview: Peter gives a photo of his mother to Mia. Vico has romantic encounters with Tomas. After discovering that he lied to her, Franco confronts Miguel. Mia presents her choreography, but Roberta and Miguel break into the dance, demonstrating their talent.

videos.title: Me suena
videos.overview: Diego tries to intimidate Roberta so she does not talk about him in his work on ethics and threatens to tell the director that she hides a boy.

videos.title: Secretos no tan bien guardados
videos.overview: The ethics professor tells students to read all the papers and that he liked a lot the Roberta's work and asks her if she can read it aloud. Leon arrives at this point.

videos.title: Cosas que se deben ocultar
videos.overview: Miguel finds his room all messy and a card with a hand printed.

videos.title: La logia
videos.overview: Miguel tells Nico that the sect exists and says she was tortured and threatened with death.

videos.title: Trampa, venganza y beso
videos.overview: José can't find her tutor's name in the files. Roberta and Diego convince everyone to go to a club. Wanting to get back at her, Diego kisses Roberta.

videos.title: Fiesta
videos.overview: Esteban informs Pascual there are no fourth-year students. A brawl breaks out at the club and the police shows up. Diego finds out Tomás likes Vico.

videos.title: Tratamiento psicológico
videos.overview: Gandia won't expel Roberta but expects her to go to counseling. The Lodge members try to run Miguel over. Mia's angry that Miguel's in her home.

videos.title: No te metas con mi novia
videos.overview: Miguel lies and says he's worried about Celina to get into Mia's home. Diego hits Tomás for stealing his girlfriend. Nico's dad is very sick.

videos.title: A la hora de bailar
videos.overview: Miguel finds Celina dancing and tells her to confront Mia. After, Roberta and Miguel expose Mia for not wanting Celina to be part of the dance group.

videos.title: Expulsión
videos.overview: The Lodge beats Nico up. Roberta's dance group beats Mia's at the auditions. Celina doesn't want to be Mia's friend anymore. Diego finds Marcelino.

videos.title: Chantaje
videos.overview: Roberta becomes Diego's slave for fear he'll tell on her. Pascual tells Vico she must leave the school. Mia and Roberta fight in the middle of class.

videos.title: Se extraña a Vico
videos.overview: Celina tells Miguel she is going to kill herself if he leaves her. The dance teacher wants Mia back in the group. Roberta's with Mia in favor of Vico.

videos.title: Celina obsesionada
videos.overview: Alma finds out Lupita's been taking Roberta's place during counseling. Celina confronts Mia over Miguel. Leon tells Diego to put Roberta in her place.

videos.title: ¿Qué tiene Celina?
videos.overview: Mia's punished for leading the protest in favor of Vico. Marcelino shows Roberta how much he loves her. Mia and Miguel find Celina in very bad shape.

videos.title: El nuevo
videos.overview: Mia tries to kiss Miguel but gets cold feet. Alma asks Roberta what she's been spending so much money on. Both Roberta and Mia like the new student.

videos.title: Cita ¿arruinada?
videos.overview: Mia's not allowed out and so her date's ruined. Miguel gets Celina to understand they have to split. Roberta has a plan to get out of Diego's grip.

videos.title: La mentira de Roberta
videos.overview: Franco asks Miguel to keep an eye on Mia. Roberta's going out with Joaquín but she lies about her parents. Pilar confronts her mom for cheating.

videos.title: Discreción y chantaje
videos.overview: Joaquín asks Roberta to be discreet about them. Diego has Roberta do his history assignment. Miguel gets the Lodge to think the old Lodge is back.

videos.title: Doble cara
videos.overview: Joaquín rejects Mia in front of Miguel and convinces her to keep their relationship secret. Miguel learns that Joaquín is playing with both Roberta and Mia.

videos.title: El cassette
videos.overview: Roberta rips into Diego for spreading gossip and tells him she's going to send the tape with his name to all the radio stations as pay back.

videos.title: Venganza y verdad
videos.overview: Marcelino apologizes to Roberta for thinking she gave him up. Mia won't accept Celina's apology. Roberta finds out Diego didn't tell on her.

videos.title: Delatores
videos.overview: León finds out about the tape and slaps Diego, but Tomás takes the blame. Celina tells Mia about Joaquín and Roberta. A drunken Diego hits his Dad.

videos.title: La mamá de Roberta
videos.overview: Mía buys Celina a dance outfit. Joaquín finds out Alma is Roberta's mom. Vico tells Mía she'll lose Joaquín if she doesn't sleep with him.

videos.title: ¿Embarazada?
videos.overview: Roberta tells Alma she's pregnant and that she broke up with Joaquín. Madariaga advises Diego to fight for what he wants and not give up. Mia asks Giovanni for a favor.

videos.title: Mi padre es narco
videos.overview: Mía finds out that Miguel told Joaquín that her dad is a drug dealer. Roberta rejects Joaquín's sexual advances. Madariaga punishes Mía and Miguel.

videos.title: Qué quieren los padres
videos.overview: Nico's parents want Karen for him, but he likes Lupita. Miguel tells Joaquín the truth about Franco. Roberta gets mad at Enrique for being interested in Alma.

videos.title: El divorcio
videos.overview: Roberta attacks Vico. León tells Diego that his mom wants a divorce but since that would look bad for his image, he has to choose to stay with him.

videos.title: No querer ver la verdad
videos.overview: Roberta tells Teo he's not guilty of his brother's death. Diego tells Roberta that Joaquín is cheating on her with Mia so she pushes him down the stairs.

videos.title: Accidentes
videos.overview: Teo wants to know if his brother was high when the accident happened, but his parents deny it. Roberta tells Mía that Joaquín has been seeing both of them.

videos.title: Decepción
videos.overview: Alma gets Roberta to tell her what happened. Franco finds Mía singing at a cafe and punishes her. Celina tells Mía Vico and Miguel were together.

videos.title: Lupita no es judía
videos.overview: Vico is mad at Celina for saying Miguel spent the night with her. Nico's mom is upset when she learns that Lupita isn't Jewish.

videos.title: Falso rumor
videos.overview: Mía and Roberta get everyone to think that Joaquín is gay. Nico breaks up with Lupita. Miguel and Diego hear that the cafe wants to hire the band.

videos.title: Orden en la escuela
videos.overview: Mr. Mendiola threatens to fire Pascual. Miguel tells Franco that he's afraid Mía might try to kill herself. Tomás is worried about Diego's self-kidnapping.

videos.title: Mejor ser diferente
videos.overview: León thwarts Diego's plans and has the bodyguard who helped arrested. Enrique tells Diego he is acting like his father and advises him not to.

videos.title: Invitación para cantar
videos.overview: Celina confronts Miguel over Vico. Roberta invites Celina to sing with the band. Robert and Lupita think that Jose Lujan is stealing food and selling it.

videos.title: La burla
videos.overview: Celina confronts Miguel over Vico. Roberta invites Celina to sing with the band. Robert and Lupita think that Jose Lujan is stealing food and selling it.

videos.title: Ataques de pánico
videos.overview: Diego is disappointed his mom went back to his dad. Roberta pretends to have panic attacks so Pascual won't expel her. Pascual hires Esteban back.

videos.title: Discusiones y golpes
videos.overview: Miguel hits Giovanni when he finds out he's with Celina as a favor. Diego argues with Roberta and says one of them has to leave the band.

videos.title: No se vayan
videos.overview: Miguel asks both Roberta and Diego to stay in the band. Mía has to go to the show with Miguel. Alma brings Marcelino and Dulce to visit Roberta and Lupita at school.

videos.title: Lavado de dinero
videos.overview: Pascual agrees to start a foundation, but the real purpose is to launder money. Roberta pretends to be with Diego in front of León.

videos.title: La verdad siempre se sabe
videos.overview: Miguel's mother gets upset when she learns about him attending Elite Way School. In fear of The Lodge, Vico breaks up with Miguel. Franco and Miguel's mother meet.

videos.title: Viaje de fin de año
videos.overview: Franco invites Miguel and his family to celebrate Christmas at his house. Miguel's mother is confused at why Miguel is going back to high school.

videos.title: Madres
videos.overview: Mía confronts her father asking why he never talks about her mother. Miguel and his mother argue; he reveals his plan to avenge his father's death.

videos.title: La foto de Vico
videos.overview: Franco sends Alma a message saying he won't be intimidated. Esteban destroys José Lujan's homework. Only the boys are allowed to be in the dance contest.

videos.title: Dinero
videos.overview: Nico's dad is very sick, so the guys from the band decide to give him the money from their first singing gig to help. Miguel asks Franco for a loan.

videos.title: Navidad
videos.overview: Pascual wants Roberta to apologize to Hilda but Alma comes to put the teacher straight before it can happen. Roberta invites Teo and José Lujan to her house for Christmas.

videos.title: Mía no confía en Miguel
videos.overview: Mía doesn't want Miguel to have the check her father has given her to give to him. Roberta gets mad at Mía for thinking Miguel lied about Nico's dad.

videos.title: Boxeo
videos.overview: Roberta gets revenge on Mía by making Mia think he father died. Joaquín offers Tomás work running drugs. Mía and Roberta have a legitimate boxing match.

videos.title: ¿Por qué pelearon?
videos.overview: Everyone thinks Mía and Roberta fought over Joaquín. Tomás doesn't want to run drugs but is threatened by Joaquín. Nico plans to quit school to take care of his family.

videos.title: Droga en la escuela
videos.overview: Mía apologizes to Nico. Madariaga finds out that Joaquín is selling drugs in the school. Mía asks Alma for confirmation that Franco is dating his lawyer, Valeria.

videos.title: Viaje a Cozumel
videos.overview: Carlos accuses Madariaga of taking bribes from León for Diego to pass his class. Nico says his goodbyes to Miguel and Teo. Celina shuns Mia.

videos.title: Fiesta en la playa
videos.overview: After he is taken to the principal's office for the rumor of drugs being sold in the school, Joaquín denies everything and puts the blame on Tomás. Roberta and Mia both don't want to spend New Year's with their parents. Their friends throw a beach party and the band performs.

videos.title: Año Nuevo
videos.overview: Miguel saves Mia from a possible self-induced drowning; they kiss. Nico accepts his mother's conditions. José steals some papers and Teo takes the blame.

videos.title: La fundación del director
videos.overview: Peter asks Mia if she knows that Franco is with Valeria. Tomás's dad finds out about Pascual's foundation and wants to become a part of it.

videos.title: Obligado a vender droga
videos.overview: Tomás reveals to his friends that Joaquín's forcing him to sell drugs. Joaquín wants Tomás to run drugs outside as well as inside of school. Mia and Celina find out Vico's been lying.

videos.title: Tomás quiere escapar
videos.overview: Tomás decides to run away after the threat of expulsion from the school. Miguel warns Joaquín to tell the truth. Madariaga wants to call the police to handle the situation of drugs in the school.

videos.title: Venganza
videos.overview: The girls get back at their dance professor, Lulu. Mia gets Miguel thrown out of the mall. Alma comes up with a plan to sabotage Franco and Valeria's romance.

videos.title: Celos
videos.overview: Roberta gets mad at Alma because she's friends with Mia. Madariaga warns Galia to keep an eye on Pilar since she's in a relationship with Joaquín.

videos.title: Mía se siente herida
videos.overview: Mia cries after she hears what Miguel thinks of her and seeing him kissing Julieta. Roberta is kicked out by Lupita's mom for playing with Lupita's sister, Dulce.

videos.title: Drogas y deporte
videos.overview: Pilar tells her mother, Galia, that Joaquín doesn't do drugs because he's an athlete. Alma is afraid that Roberta's father will take Roberta away.

videos.title: ¿Roberta se va a España?
videos.overview: Alma tells Franco that Roberta's father wants to take Roberta away with him to Spain. Marcelino tells Roberta that her mother is afraid of losing her to her father.

videos.title: Diego se enfurece
videos.overview: Alma tells Roberta that she can't stop her father from taking her away to Spain and that she loves her very much. Pilar sees Vico and Joaquín kissing.

videos.title: Decidirse por una banda
videos.overview: When Diego finds out Roberta is in two bands he tells her to pick one or the other. Valeria breaks up with Franco because of Mia. Meanwhile, Mia tells on Miguel and Julieta.

videos.title: Cartas de amor
videos.overview: Mia asks her dad to stop Miguel from getting expelled after she told on him and Julieta. Esteban receives love letters and thinks they are from Mia.

videos.title: Lulú pide disculpas
videos.overview: Lulu apologizes to the students for lying. Celina asks Mia to take her place at the band's rehearsal. Vico demands that Joaquín breaks up with Pilar.

videos.title: El temor
videos.overview: Giovanni gives his support to Mia. Fearing the Lodge might hurt Julieta, Miguel breaks up with her. By Diego's request, Facundo turns down Roberta.

videos.title: Ruptura y reconciliación
videos.overview: Joaquín breaks up with Pilar because she won't sleep with him. Vico thinks that Mia told Esteban about the love letters she's been sending him. Roberta gets manipulated by Diego.

videos.title: En reemplazo
videos.overview: Valeria pretends to be a photographer for the school to get close to Mia. Miguel warns Mia about Esteban. Roberta makes her choice of which band to stay in.

videos.title: Golpes y presentaciones
videos.overview: Miguel and Esteban get into a fist fight. Joaquín breaks up with Vico by lying that the Lodge might come after her. However, Pilar tells Vico that Joaquín and her are dating again.

videos.title: Incomunicada
videos.overview: Miguel admonishes Julieta for going out with her former boyfriend, who is dangerous. Valeria tells Franco she spent the day with Mia. Paola tries to seduce Diego.

videos.title: Obligadas a acostarse
videos.overview: Miguel asks Teo to help get him in as a member at the Lodge. Mia finds out Vanessa is really the woman dating her father, Valeria. Paola is hired by León to sleep with Diego.

videos.title: Cosas del pasado
videos.overview: Diego reveals to Paola he's a virgin. Miguel is asked by Franco to find Mia, who has run away after she finds out her father and Valeria had a history.

videos.title: Trampa
videos.overview: Miguel comes up with a plan to get Rodrigo to invite Teo into the Lodge. Celina tells Mia that Valeria could tell her everything she wants to know about her mother.

videos.title: Creer o no creer
videos.overview: Antonio punishes Roberta and locks her up for throwing the gifts he gave her out the window. Pascual warns Pilar that he doesn't want to see her with Joaquín. Valeria tells Mia that her mom was promiscuous and used drugs, but Franco denies it.

videos.title: Haciendo lo que no se debe
videos.overview: Julieta breaks up with Miguel once she figures out he is in love with Mia. Teo and Miguel pretend to fight. Franco gets upset with Valeria for telling Mia about her mom.

videos.title: No te drogues
videos.overview: Lupita tells Mia of how Miguel got Teo into the Lodge. José makes Teo believe that Roberta is in love with him.

videos.title: Autoestima
videos.overview: Mia accuses Miguel to Esteban of spying on her in the bathroom. Miguel and Julieta begin dating again.

videos.title: Una relación seria
videos.overview: Esteban finds out the letters aren't Mia's, but tells her, if she wants a real relationship where she is loved, he'll be waiting. Tomás gets beat up by a strange man when he goes to visit Lulu.

videos.title: Cambios
videos.overview: Mia confides in Alma about Franco's change since his relationship with Valeria started. Nico thinks Lupita is after Karen's cousin.

videos.title: Decir la verdad
videos.overview: León reminds Paola that he did her a favor, and forbids her to ever see or go near Diego again. Mia accepts Giovanni's request to start dating.

videos.title: ¿Sobredosis?
videos.overview: Everyone laughs when Giovanni reveals that him and Mia are dating. Joaquín faints in gym class after taking drugs; Esteban doesn't let the fellow classmates get help.

videos.title: Ascenso
videos.overview: Roberta ruins her dad's fancy dinner by embarrassing him and pretending he beats her. Mia plans to get evidence of Joaquín's drug business.

videos.title: No creas los chismes
videos.overview: Lupita finds Mia's diary in Nico's belongings, not knowing that Miguel is the one who took it. Franco tells Mia to ignore the rumours about her mother.

videos.title: Rehabilitación
videos.overview: Diego finds out about the ring Paola received from his father, León, and breaks up with her. Mia plans to get revenge on Miguel for reading her diary. Joaquín starts rehab.

videos.title: La verdad sobre mi vida
videos.overview: Mia asks Raquel to tell Miguel, when he's with Julieta or alone, that she is crazy for him. Paola confesses to Diego about her past.

videos.title: Diego vuelve con Paola
videos.overview: Mia learns the truth about her mom's past. After getting back with Paola, Diego hides her in the school.

videos.title: Roberta regresa
videos.overview: Giovanni gives his full support to Mia after she learns how her mother died. After talking to Valeria, Mia accepts the truth and the fact that her mom was a hoe.

videos.title: Mía se va
videos.overview: Roberta finds out about Diego and Paola dating. Mia runs away from school and goes to stay with Alma. Meanwhile, Miguel searches for Mia.

videos.title: Mía está con Alma
videos.overview: Giovanni is angry that Miguel goes to look for Mia. Roberta finds Mia at Alma's and gets upset. Miguel finds Mia at Alma's and they kiss; they leave and spend the day together.

videos.title: Olvida lo que pasó
videos.overview: Before returning to school, Miguel tells Mia that they have to forget everything that happened between them and they can't begin dating. However, Miguel ends his relationship with Julieta.

videos.title: Roberta está celosa
videos.overview: Due to jealousy, Roberta tells her mom to choose her or Mía. Miguel decides to tell Mía he has feelings for her; they decide to keep their relationship secret.

videos.title: Mía no cree en su papá
videos.overview: Mia loses trust in her dad. Franco believes that Alma is turning Mia against him. Miguel wants his relationship with Mia to be public.

videos.title: ¿Alma y Franco juntos?
videos.overview: When Alma comes to Franco's house, she finds him drunk; he kisses her. Mia tells Giovanni the truth of how she feels and breaks up with him.

videos.title: Mía y Miguel
videos.overview: Valeria warns Alma to stay away from Franco. After Mia and Miguel kiss, she runs away. However; she returns, apologizes, and ask him to make her a woman.

videos.title: Celina sale de la banda
videos.overview: Celina quits the band and asks Mia to take her place. Miguel takes Mia to her house to reconcile with her father.

videos.title: Téo, aceptado en la logia
videos.overview: Teo tells Miguel he passed the test given by the Lodge members and it's all thanks to his girlfriend, Roberta. Franco tells Mia about her mom.

videos.title: Fin de semana
videos.overview: Franco tells Miguel that Mia has been happier and more mature since she fell in love. Carlo, Mia's uncle comes to visit; him along with Franco, Valeria, Alma, Mia, and Miguel spend the weekend together.

videos.title: Miguel pide disculpas
videos.overview: Paola tells Roberta everything that happened between León and her. Miguel apologizes to Mia for exploding on her about his father.

videos.title: Show exitoso
videos.overview: Giovanni, Mia, Roberta, Diego, Miguel, and Mia have a successful show. Giovanni's mother embarrasses him in front of Tomas and his mother when they're invited to dinner.

videos.title: Avergonzado
videos.overview: Miguel flips out when Mia invites his mother and sister to a family trip. Luisa finds out that Giovanni is ashamed of his parents, but she plays along with the lie he invented.

videos.title: ¿A Roberta le gusta Carlo?
videos.overview: Alma asks Roberta if she likes Carlo. Lupita asks Nico what's up with Miguel, because Mia is worried about him.

videos.title: Mía o Julieta
videos.overview: Oso wants to convince Marcelino to steal money to help him. Nico tells Lupita that Miguel feels like he's betraying his father because he's in love with Mia.

videos.title: No está listo para tener novia
videos.overview: Miguel goes to Julieta's house to tell her that he is with Mia. She kisses him and Lupita sees them.

videos.title: Venganza y apuesta
videos.overview: Lupita tells Mia that Miguel is dating her for revenge. Mia insults Miguel and tells the whole school that she was with him because of a bet.

videos.title: A la sombra de su fama
videos.overview: Roberta is afraid her mother's reputation will cast a shadow on her career in the band. Marcelino's brother escapes and has him ask for money from Alma and Pepa and steal from other places. Esteban overworks José until she collapses.

videos.title: Nuevo prefecto
videos.overview: Carlo tells Roberta he is interested in her mom, not her. José reveals to Teo that she was the one who sent the emails, not Roberta.

videos.title: Cambios en la banda
videos.overview: Mia quits the band and Miguel is pleased. However, Diego tells her it would be a mistake to quit and Vico convinces her to stay in the band.

videos.title: Invitados a Otro Rollo
videos.overview: The band needs to get exposure so they try to get on the Otro Rollo TV show. Franco gives Carlo another chance at working for the family company.

videos.title: La recomendada
videos.overview: Giovanni and Tomás cover for Diego with Alicia. Everyone in the school finds out in another anonymous letter that José made fun of Teo.

videos.title: Delatores y encubridores
videos.overview: Roberta asks Teo to forgive her. José blames Lupita for writing and sending out the anonymous letters.

videos.title: La banda se llama RBD
videos.overview: Giovanni, Mia, Roberta, Diego, Miguel, and Lupita decide to name their band Rebelde aka RBD. Lenny Kravitz gives Roberta his guitar at the Otro Rollo.

videos.title: RBD en Otro Rollo
videos.overview: Adal Ramones listens to the band sing and invites them on the show. RBD performs on the Otro Rollo show. Meanwhile, their closest friends prevent others students and their respective parents from watching the show. Gastón and Mia first meet.

videos.title: El horario de las clases
videos.overview: The new math teacher, Renata, refuses to help the kids with the schoolwork. Roberta and José mix up Hilda's first love and the important guest speaker; they lock Hilda and the speaker in a room together. Lupita tells Nico she has to go back to be with her sister.

videos.title: Una confusión
videos.overview: The band gets news that the recording label wants them to sing other songs and not their own. Alma goes on live TV to find Marcelino. Gastón has it out for Roberta for the mishap, however, she succeeds in getting Hilda and her first love face to face.

videos.title: Diego y Roberta, otra vez
videos.overview: Roberta kisses Diego and Paola tells him to quit the band. Nico asks Lupita to not drop out for her future. Marcelino calls Roberta to say goodbye. Celina is put in charge of picking the dance members.

videos.title: Diego se va de la banda
videos.overview: Mia reflects on her and Miguel's precious moments. Diego decides to leave the band and Roberta is blamed for it. Alma decides to be the dance group's choreographer. Gastón calls Mia out of class, she cries about Miguel and he comforts her.

videos.title: Cuidemos el bosque
videos.overview: Mia start a campaign/fundraiser to help save the Chapultepec Forest. Teo tells the Lodge that José was the one responsible for the anonymous letters out of fear and spite. Lupita decides to stay in school. Gastón gives Mia a present. Miguel becomes suspicious of Gastón.

videos.title: Diego quiere a Paola
videos.overview: Diego tells his mom of his love for Paola; she asks to meet her. Gastón overhears José and Vico talking about him; he threatens José. Miguel is allowed access to Franco's files. Roberta tells Facundo not to let Diego into his band. León gets pictures of Paola with Diego.

videos.title: Enojos
videos.overview: León threatens Paola on the phone and demands to speak to Diego. Mia distracts Gastón so the band won't be seen; he embraces her. Roberta tricks the principal to stop her mother from teaching choreography at the school. Mia gets mad at Miguel for telling the everyone that her and Gastón are dating.

videos.title: Acusada
